title: Turkmen — ICAO Doc 9303 ASCII (passport MRZ)
authority: ICAO Doc 9303 Part 3 (8th ed., 2021), §6.A applied to the Turkmen Latin alphabet (1993/1999)
description: Turkmen Latin names folded to the ICAO MRZ alphabet: Ä→A, Ç→C, Ň→N, Ö→O, Ş→S, Ü→U, Ý→Y, Ž→Z; W and J are kept (Nyýazow → Nyyazow, Berdimuhamedow unchanged).
notes: No source was found on Turkmen passport MRZ practice; this is the mechanical ICAO §6.A fold (single-letter options, not AE/OE/UE). Treat as a best guess.
English-phonetic alternatives to generate: Ç→CH, Ş→SH, Ž→ZH, Ň→NG, J→DZH, W→V, -ow→-ov (Niyazov, Berdymukhamedov); Russian-form ICAO via Cyrillic: Ниязов → NIIAZOV.
Legacy 1993–1999 letters: ÿ→ý and ñ→ň are accepted. The currency-sign letters ($ ¢ £ ¥) and ſ are not mapped (aliasing ſ would also capture capital S).
